key_insight: Classical Houdayer cluster updates amplify the diversity of quantum-generated maximum independent set solutions, with gains of up to 11,923×.
engineering_relevance: Post-processing can extract more distinct high-quality configurations from existing quantum measurements without additional quantum sampling.
method: Seed solution sets with measurements from QuEra’s Aquila analog quantum device.
Apply classical Houdayer cluster updates to expand the sampled solution sets.
Measure diversity amplification and manifold coverage using known exact ground-state degeneracies.
evidence_signal: Across 43 instances, median diversity amplification was 24.3× and median ground-state manifold recovery was 21%, with complete recovery for six instances and improved solution quality in some cases.
watch_item: The method is non-ergodic, so it cannot guarantee complete ground-state manifold coverage.
paper_title: Efficient Ground-State Manifold Amplification for Rydberg Atom Arrays via Houdayer Cluster Updates
